name: Gala de commandement
historicalBrief: The Boss MGS3 en tenue habillée fonctionnelle ivoire et noire, col sobre, coupe adaptée aux épaules, cheveux et cicatrice conservés; aucun effacement d’âge.

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. THE BOSS, Metal Gear Solid 3 incarnation, mature strong woman with exact stern aged face, blonde hair swept back into low ponytail, commanding shoulders and athlete build of the attached first figure. Costume OC-005 Gala de commandement: elegant functional ivory command dinner jacket with a sober black high stand collar (NOT a bow tie), asymmetric black piping, two understated black closure tabs and a minimal black waist sash, tailored to her strong shoulders; black tailored trousers with discreet movement gussets and flat polished ivory/black ankle boots. Dark understated gloves and a restrained left hip holster with period appropriate proportions. Preserve visible facial age; her known torso scar remains covered by the complete jacket, do not invent facial wounds. No de-aging, no glamorous cleavage, no young model face. Stance relaxed but disciplined, right-facing. This specific jacket is a fresh named CQC command gala design, visually distinct from the already-existing ordinary white-lapel bow-tie tuxedo.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
Faithfulness of identity is based on physically viewed preserved CQC incarnation references; no pixel-perfect Konami model certification.
No left-facing draw, animation continuity, hitboxes or playable admission delivered by this source.
